prompt: Create a production game material texture: an exactly square, perfectly tileable 2 by 2 grid of painted Qing Forbidden City tianhua ceiling coffers, target 2048x2048 opaque sRGB albedo. Orthographic straight-on view, as if looking directly upward at a flat painted ceiling plane, but absolutely no perspective or cast shading. FOUR equally sized square compartments, arranged 2 columns and 2 rows. Deep indigo and muted teal painted ground. Each compartment has one central circular flat gold painted medallion, alternating coiled stylized Chinese dragon and lotus floral rosette, small gold-and-teal corner scroll ornaments in all four corners. Green narrow battens separate compartments, with small gold pinhead rosettes at intersections. Palette from supplied game reference: warm ochre-gold paint, lapis/indigo and muted jade teal; DO NOT reproduce the hallway, pillars, floor, perspective or lighting from it. This is just the repeatable CEILING PAINT PATTERN. Factual structure follows Palace Museum description of hard tianhua: intersecting wooden strips, square wooden panels with round dragon or flower motif. It is not a single octagonal zaojing caisson. Flat diffuse uniform illumination, no shadow gradients, no raised bevel shading, no highlights or metallic glare: all color is pigment/albedo. Subtle hand-painted brush texture, clean readable elegant motifs, restrained aging. Seamless periodicity both directions: each outside boundary passes through the exact MIDLINE of a green batten, with half-width battens at outer edges so joining copies gives the same width as internal battens. Intersections at image corners are quarter gold rosettes that assemble into full rosettes when tiled. Top edge matches bottom, left matches right in color and motif alignment. No outer border, no extra framing, no margin, no text, no numbers, no watermark. Image fills canvas edge-to-edge. Only the 2x2 repeating flat pattern, no room or object mockup.
